meta_description:
lakshmisharath on September 11, 2026: "A hundred years of food, tradition and memories.

Udupi Sri Krishna Bhavan in Balepet has been part of Bangalore since 1926. For generations of Bangaloreans, it has been much more than a restaurant—it is nostalgia, a family tradition and almost a rite of passage.

Places like this don’t simply preserve the flavours of a city. They become part of its story.

#UdupiSriKrishnaBhavan #OldBangalore #BangaloreFood #BengaluruHeritage

Have you been to Udupi Shri Krishna Bhavan in Balapet ?".
